name: vnd-ai-sdlc
description: VNDIRECT AI-SDLC harness, framework-agnostic layer. Upstream: Stage A discovery (idea-card, problem-canvas, market-scan, discovery-report), Stage B definition (context-doc, brd, prd with the two-way trace check that catches scope creep), Stage C design (sa-view, srs, ui-spec, test-strategy, threat model via security-review), and /gate recording all five human gates G1-G5 with their per-gate evidence rules. Agents: pm-analyst (FS18), architect (FS20), px-designer (FS19), security (FS14), reviewer. Delivery: plan-feature, spec, adr, review, security-review, pr, status, agent-metrics, update-memory, abort, notify-merge. A governed skill lifecycle (skill-new, skill-submit, skill-approve, skill-sync). Twenty-one versioned templates covering every phase-boundary artefact from Company Context and Issue Report through BRD, PRD, SRS, Threat Model and the traceability manifest (v2 — now covers gates G1-G5). /harness-init scaffolds all of it into any repo, including a Company Context instance stub. Bundled MCP server exposing Confluence, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Microsoft Teams and Claude Code trigger tools; /pr works on both GitHub and GitLab. Pair with vnd-ai-sdlc-stockbook for Flutter specifics.
